changelog: v0.7.3: 1) Standardized Antigravity Session Titles: eliminates 'Favorite Animal Blue Dolphin' and normalizes all Antigravity session titles on disk and in conversation_summaries.db to 'AI Conversation'; 2) Default Disabled Live Mode: ensures hands-free Live Mode always boots disabled (OFF) upon entering the website; 3) 3D VR In-HUD Live Mode Button Debouncing: removed duplicate trigger event dispatching between pointer select and controller render polling, adding 350ms click debouncing to ensure clean, reliable single toggling in WebXR.
